topics.title: TMail web slow to load
topics.summary: TMail web is slow to load, possibly due to cache-control or web configuration.

caseDetails.evidence: cache-control or a web configuration problem

topics.supportKnowledgeSummary: Support knowledge lookup returned useful customer-facing knowledge for this topic.

lastUserVerbatim: TMail web is very slow to load. It feels like the browser is downloading too much data every time. Could this be related to cache-control or a web configuration problem?
lastBotVerbatim: We understand that TMail web is very slow to load and you're wondering if it could be related to cache-control or a web configuration issue. TMail-Web may experience slow loading times due to misconfigured caching settings, specifically the `Cache-Control: no-cache` directive, which prevents the use of HTTP 304 Not Modified responses. Could you please tell us which browser and version you are using to access TMail-Web and whether this issue is consistent or intermittent?
